h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hapur

items.pText: Hapur, east of Ghaziabad, is a market town known for its grain trade and its papad. Marriage lawns, farmhouses, schools and residential colonies around the town also ask us for play areas. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,150 km away, delivered by road to western Uttar Pradesh.

A kids' corner at a marriage lawn or party venue is used very differently from a school ground. It sees large groups of children for a few hours, often after dark, dressed in their best clothes and with little supervision. For these venues we suggest compact play stations with enclosed decks and smooth surfaces, where children are unlikely to snag clothes or wander off. Place the corner within sight of the main seating, so parents can enjoy the function and still keep watch.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Setting up a play corner at a wedding or event venue

c: Keep the play corner close to the guest seating but away from the stage, the catering area and any generator or cables. Choose pieces with enclosed decks and tunnel slides, which suit children in long dresses better than open climbing nets. Venues around Hapur stay busy through the winter wedding season, when evenings are cold and foggy, so light the area well from nearby poles. Rubber flooring keeps the corner clean and firm when the lawn is wet.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,150 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What play equipment suits a marriage lawn?
items.a: Compact play stations with enclosed decks and tunnel slides work well, since children often play in formal clothes. Place them where guests can see them and away from catering and power cables.

items.q: Can the play corner be used at night?
items.a: Yes, if the area is well lit. Our equipment does not come with lighting, so plan light from nearby poles or the venue's own fittings before the layout is fixed.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Hapur and the rest of western Uttar Pradesh by road, and install it through our team or a dealer in North India.
